description: Structure of the residual 1.9% hallucination rate: four failure modes, each with an identifiable mechanism

failure_modes.mechanism: Coincidental alignment: an injected stereotype-priming perturbation elicits a response matching what the behavioural profile would have predicted anyway
Plausible portmanteaus: invented brand names composed from morphemes common in the category slip past verbatim checks
Boundary artefacts from fiscal-to-calendar week realignment rather than gross anachronisms
Paraphrased leakage: fragments of persona instructions surface reworded in open-text responses (verbatim leakage is caught essentially always)

finding: The residual 1.9% is a structured set of failure modes, each with an identifiable mechanism and a known detection cost. Every surviving failure mode lives at a boundary, suggesting the next material quality gains lie in sharper boundary definitions rather than stronger models.
